messages:
Kai Ortega: hey team! i'm Kai (he/him), started today on Eng-Platform. based in Guadalajara (UTC-6). i love tabletop games, mechanical keyboards, and small succulents that pretend to be cacti. :) excited to be here! :wave:
Ben: welcome Kai!! :tada: tabletop night is a must. what games are you into?
Kai Ortega: thanks Ben! big into quick euros like 'Wingspan' and lighter social deduction like 'One Night Ultimate Werewolf'. also down for a Puzzle Party.
Tejas: welcome Kai  happy to host a virtual boardgame evening sometime. evenings UTC-5/UTC-6 tend to work for me.
Mei: hi Kai! i'm in SGP (UTC+8) but usually can join later evening sessions if we rotate times. also curious about keyboard recs  i'm thinking about a silent switch option for open office days.
Kai Ortega: i use low-profile tactile switches and a foam-lined case for quiet typing; happy to share links. for a first boardgame night maybe we do a 60-min casual session of 'Sushi Go Party' or a few rounds of 'Codenames' to keep it easy for mixed timezones.
Anya: :raised_hands: love that. quick poll  react with :game_die: for evenings (US friendly), :watch: for late afternoons (Europe friendly), :crescent_moon: for rotating monthly times. or reply with specific days that work.
Ben: :game_die:
Tejas: :game_die:
Mei: :crescent_moon:
Kai Ortega: majority leaning evenings — cool. propose Fri Mar 19 20:00 UTC-6 (2hrs) for an in-person/remote hybrid night: hub folks can bring snacks, remote folks join via Board Game Arena / Tabletop Simulator link. Thoughts?
Anya: that could work. if it's hybrid, can we get a small table in the lounge reserved?
calendar-bot: Event created: "Boardgame Night  Kai's Welcome"  Fri Mar 19 20:00 UTC-6  2 hours  Invites sent to participants.
Ben: got the invite, i'll grab some chips and bubble tea. :chipmunk: 
Mei: i'll try to make the later half of the session. sounds fun!
Kai Ortega: awesome, thanks y'all! i'll post a short sign-up with game preferences and whether people will be remote or in-hub. also happy to answer any onboarding q's if anyone's been through the Eng-Platform setup recently.
